rule: No P0 approval without executable verification evidence.

contracts.challenge: Identity authority, lifecycle, scope and source must be authoritative; phone/number alone cannot establish identity.
Channel adapters must expose normalized capabilities while isolating provider credentials and regional constraints.
Communication events require complete correlation, policy, authorization and lifecycle integrity.
blockers: transition enforcement and immutable event evidence not verified

contracts.challenge: AI action must remain separated from authorization and execution, with exact tool scope and idempotency.
Policy decisions must be deny-by-default and evaluate subject, capability, resource, data, tenant, workspace, region and assurance.
blockers: policy decision point is not production-backed

contracts.challenge: Workforce assignment must be an explicit orchestration decision and must not grant authorization.
Evidence must prove provenance, correlation and verification state without treating controlled snapshots as production truth.
Iran/China operation modes must fail closed during degradation/isolation and preserve residency, authorization, audit and recovery invariants.

next_gate: Implement runtime contract enforcement and executable API verification before any production claim.
